<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsd:schema xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/04fdbd4d-384f-4136-a5f7-486b82bc57d0.xsd" xmlns:ibmbpm="http://lombardi.ibm.com/schema/" targetNamespace="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/04fdbd4d-384f-4136-a5f7-486b82bc57d0.xsd">
  <xsd:element name="_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9Request" type="_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9Request"/>
  <xsd:element name="_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9Response" type="_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9Response"/>
  <xsd:complexType name="_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9Request">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element name="accountName" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation>
          <xsd:documentation>Account name</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="next_page_token" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true">
          <xsd:documentation>token to obtain next set of records</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="filter" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true">
          <xsd:documentation>The [`filter`](https://loopback.io/doc/en/lb4/Where-filter.html) is a type of filter clause that consists of one or more logical conditions to match, it is a way of achieving subsetting of data based on the specified conditions</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9Response">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9" type="_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9_200Type" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9Response']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9']">
        <xsd:annotation alternateOldName="_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9_200" optional="true" responseCode="200">
          <xsd:documentation>Successful execution</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="_5ae816c1ab548458b3d587db99586b9_200Type">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element name="reasoning" type="xsd:string"/>
      <xsd:element name="reorder_quantity" type="xsd:int">
        <xsd:annotation format="int32"/>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
</xsd:schema>
